outroLine: Your whole order flow, at a glance.

beats.shot: Land on /bridge. Cursor settles by the Dashboard title; the live topology fills the frame.
beats.vo: This is the dashboard, the first thing you see every morning. One look tells you what's flowing, and what needs you.

beats.shot: Cursor traces the topology: buyer nodes left, supplier nodes right, wires between; rests near an amber at-risk route.
beats.vo: The map is your live order flow. Buyers on the left, suppliers on the right, and every line is a route that is actually carrying orders. Thicker lines carry more volume, and an amber route is asking for attention.

beats.shot: Cursor moves to the time-window control (Today / 7d / 30d / All) and clicks All.
beats.vo: The numbers follow the time window you pick. Today, the last week, the last month, or everything.

beats.shot: Scroll down to the KPI strip; cursor sweeps across Orders received, Orders delivered, Urgent exceptions, Auto-processed.
beats.vo: Below the map, the counts that matter. Orders received, orders delivered, exceptions that need you now, and how much went through hands-free.

beats.shot: Cursor moves over the Supplier health panel (per-supplier delivery success bars), then the In transit panel.
beats.vo: Supplier health shows the delivery success rate for each supplier, so a route that is degrading shows up here before it becomes a fire. And In transit is what's moving through the pipeline right now.

beats.shot: Scroll back to the top; cursor clicks the amber 'Review exceptions →' banner; the Exceptions screen lands.
beats.vo: And when something needs a decision, the banner takes you straight to the exception queue. One click, and you're working the problem. That's the whole point of the dashboard.
